source: docs/G5_CONTRACT_ISSUE_LEDGER.md section 7 of the contract-proof line: 'the branch's own test/v3 suite runs 29 passing and 76 failing' with the draft patches applied

stage_1_clock_shim.reason_remaining: fixture claim attestation lacks clusterId/evidenceHash (patched ABI)

tests: cell validity: refuses values that are not canonical / wrong-resolution cell (shim computes a res-5 parent of a wrong-resolution cell)

conceptual_cluster_cap.note: a holder taking 2 deeds is now bounded by the per-cluster cap (default 1) before the per-holder cap; a fixture raising maxDeedsPerCluster through the timelock would show whether the per-holder assertions still hold

conceptual_single_signer_claim_abi.note: tests call claim() with the single-signature struct; the patch disables it

conceptual_single_sided_scoring.note: submitScore is disabled; scores are posted for both sides of a day by two keys (submitDayScores)

conceptual_scoring_grace_day.note: settlement waits one grace day after the window

caveats: the clock shim advances the in-process chain by dayId days plus 60 s before a settlement authorization is built; it is crude and can mask timing assertions
the claim shim waits 7 days after each claim so the deed is final; it therefore does not exercise the pending window (the regression proofs do)
two regression proofs fail under the shims by construction (they assert the unshimmed time and pending behaviour); they pass in the unshimmed run
